title: fix(objectql)!: refuse a projection whose every column is unknown, as an empty one is refused
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_

Fixes #27165

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx (the unknown-field Callout under Field Selection says a top-level projection whose every entry is unknown, object-form entries included, is refused 400 VALIDATION_ERROR by engine.find() / findOne(); a mix still drops the unknown ones), prose-only commit e354975f; skills/** teaches fields only as a list of real columns and needs no change.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：引擎进程内读入口 `ObjectQL.find` / `findOne` 遇到投影里每一列都是对象上不存在的列（如 `fields: ['nope']`）时，不再回退为读全部列，而是按空投影拒绝，答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`，与 #27008 对 `fields: []` 的拒绝是同一个函数、同一形状，消息里点名所请求的列。
- **为什么改**：#7589 的容忍会丢掉未知列，丢光后引擎回退 `*`，于是"更窄的请求被更宽地回答"（含 owner、组织、审计列）；REST 门早已拒绝同一请求。分诊裁定：过滤后为空的投影就是空投影，用 #27008 的拒绝。
- **风险与回滚**：低。仓内非测试调用方普查 0 个依赖该回退（见 Acceptance notes）；已知列与未知列混合时仍保留 #7589 容忍；不传 `fields` 仍读全部列。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 中 `find` / `findOne` 未知列过滤处的两行；`packages/objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts`（拒绝本体，新增命名所请求列的分支）；`packages/objectql/src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#27165]` 段。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`，预期 13/13 通过；在 `main` 上同文件 2 条失败（`find` / `findOne` 只含未知列）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`find` and `findOne` drop a requested plain column the object does not have (the #7589 tolerance). When that left nothing, both ended with `ast.fields = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : undefined`, so the driver got no projection and answered every column. Now the emptied case calls `refuseProjectionOfUnknownColumns`, a thin export over #27008's own `refuseEmptyProjection` in `empty-projection-door.ts`. No second refusal: same function, same `status: 400`, same `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, same declaration words (`Name at least one field`). The only addition is that `got` names what was asked for and says why it emptied.

| Read (registered object) | `main` | This head |
|---|---|---|
| `find(obj, { fields: ['nope'] })` | every column, no error | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, no driver read |
| `findOne(obj, { where, fields: ['nope'] })` | every column | refused the same way |
| `fields: ['nope', 'title']` | `{ title }` | unchanged (#7589 tolerance kept) |
| `fields: []` | refused (#27008) | unchanged |
| `fields` absent or `null` | every column | unchanged |
| object with no registered field map | not judged | unchanged |

`engine.ts` changes 4 lines in each of the two filter sites plus the import. The delete-cascade region (#27391, now landed) is not touched. Open drafts #27339 and #27477 edit `engine.ts` near its imports, and #27477 also edits near the two filter sites, so whichever lands later merges `main`.

## Why

Card #27165, triage `6466016076`: "a projection that is empty **after** dropping unknown columns is an empty projection, so it is refused with #27008's refusal (one rule: an empty projection is refused, never read as every column). The #7589 tolerance stays for a mix of known and unknown columns. This narrows behaviour, and the in-repo census of callers comes first."

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`: a new `[#27165]` block on the same real `ObjectQL` and exact-projecting driver double as #27008's cases. It checks `find` with `['nope','nada']` and `findOne` with `['nope']`. Each is refused with `mapDataError` status 400 and code `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the declaration's words, the requested columns named in `got`, and zero driver reads. The control is `['nope','title']`, which still reads `{ title }` on both verbs.
- Two existing pins of the old fallback now expect the refusal:
  - `query-expression-conformance.test.ts` `[#7589 GUARD] a projection of ONLY unknown plain columns still falls back to every field`, which said it was pinned "so a future tighten cannot ride in … without meeting its own ruling". Triage's answer on this card is that ruling.
  - `unprojected-read-declared-fields-conformance.test.ts` `door: an explicit projection naming ONLY a retired column`, three driver shapes. That request is still never served the retired column: it is now refused.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on this head, ablation</summary>

Red leg: the new block against the unfixed engine (commit `89938406`, tests only):

```
× find with only unknown columns is refused 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, naming them, before any driver read
× findOne with only unknown columns is refused the same way, before any driver read
Tests  2 failed | 11 passed (13)      — "expected a refusal, got an answer"
```

Green: `Tests  13 passed (13)`.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one leg per site. The test imports `./engine.js` from source, so the mutation is on source. Each leg puts the old line `ast.fields = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : undefined;` back in place of the refusal and the assignment after it:

- `find` leg: anchor 1 → 0, blob `7697ee2b` → `8beef8e9`. `Tests 1 failed | 12 passed (13)`: the `find` case. Restored: blob == HEAD (`7697ee2b`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `findOne` leg: anchor 1 → 0, blob `7697ee2b` → `56a22aca`. `Tests 1 failed | 12 passed (13)`: the `findOne` case. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Probe: the REST door and the engine on the same request</summary>

```
door   findData select ['nope']            → 400 INVALID_FIELD   "Unknown field 'nope' on object 'task_27008'. …"
engine find    fields ['nope']             → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR "ObjectQL.find('task_27008') names no field in 'fields': got ["nope"], and none of them is a field of 'task_27008' (an unknown column is dropped from a projection). …"
engine findOne fields ['nope']             → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (same sentence, findOne)
engine find    fields ['nope','title']     → [{ title: 'Ship' }]
engine find    expand { project_id: { fields: ['nope'] } } → project_id: {}   (sub-read asked for ['id'] only)
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Caller census (in-repo, before the code).** A call-text scan of every `.find(` / `.findOne(` call whose arguments mention `fields`, across non-test sources in `packages`, `examples`, `apps`, `ui` and `skills`, found 278 calls.
  - 166 name `id` in a literal list. `id` is always known, so the projection can never empty.
  - Of the other 112, every literal or constant projection names columns its object declares, checked by hand where the name was not obvious (`RECIPIENT_LOCALE_FIELD` = `locale` on `sys_user`, `PARENT_COLUMNS` on the audit gate objects).
  - The computed ones either prepend `id` (`dangling-reference-audit`, `backfill-file-references`, pinyin `companion-projection`, the plugin-security report scans, `mail-read-visibility`, sharing-rule `findMatchingRows`) or are `IDataDriver` calls, not engine calls (`secret-reference-union`, the `summaryKeyColumns` driver reads in `engine.ts`).
  - `ui/` and `client-react` reach the engine over REST, where the door already refuses unknown fields.
  - The better-auth adapter passes better-auth's own `select`, which names model fields mapped to declared columns. better-auth 1.7.12 core passes no `select` literal.
  - The flow `get_record` node passes its authored `fields`. Its `findOne` arm always adds `id` (`projectionNamingId`). Its `find` arm (limit > 1) forwards `fields` as authored. The only in-repo flow with `fields` is `recalc-estimate`, with `['start_date','end_date']` on `showcase_task`, both declared.
  - Verdict: no shipped in-repo caller relies on the fallback. The scan cannot see an options object built away from the call. The objectql suite and the dogfood battery are the runtime half of the census. Callers outside this repo (cloud) were not censused.
- **Code, measured against the card body.** The card body says REST answers `400 INVALID_FIELD`. The ruling chose #27008's refusal, so the in-process answer is `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. Both are 400, and the codes differ. A host mapping engine errors through `mapDataError` serves both 400s. Whether the two doors should share one code for this request is not decided here.
- **`expand` needs no new arm.** An `expand` entry's sub-read always names `id` (#7537), which is never dropped. A nested projection of only unknown columns therefore reads `{ id }`, strips it, and expands to `{}`. That is not every column, and it is unchanged by this PR.
- **Non-string entries.** A projection made only of non-string entries (the retired field-node object form) also empties under the filter, so it is now refused rather than read as every column. A mixed one keeps its string columns, as before.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: a shape that read before is refused, and nothing is widened. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authored key changes, and no save or publish door refuses anything new. Because of the narrowing, this PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review before the queue.
